contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C M AV[R P]ROBVS AVG ; R/ SALV[S AVG]

A silver washed radiate of Probus (AD 276-282) - reverse type Salus, draped, standing left, feeding out of patera in right hand serpent rising from altar and holding sceptre in left hand - SALVS AVG. Reece Period: 14. Obverse description: Bust of Probus, radiate, draped, right or bust of Probus, radiate, cuirassed, right. Obverse inscription: IMP C M AV[R P]ROBVS AVG.
